drivers.description: List of audio drivers and their options. Each entry specifies a driver name and a list of comma-separated key=value options. libao tries drivers in order until one succeeds.

driver.description: Name of the libao driver (e.g., alsa, pulse, oss, aoivorbis, etc.).

options.description: Options for the driver, formatted as 'key=value' strings. Example: ['device=hw:0,0', 'global=1'].

items.description: A single option in 'key=value' format. Valid keys depend on the driver; common ones include 'device', 'global', 'buffer_time', 'period_time'.
